answer: Autonomous agents resist Sybil attacks by requiring verifiable proof-of-work to forge identities, ensuring each agent represents a unique computational island rather than a coordinated fake. The protocol measures the delta between legitimate agent entropy and malicious noise, slashing stakes for entities failing this threshold. This economic barrier imposes prohibitive costs on attackers attempting to forge multiple nodes, sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance through rigorous cryptographic verification of each isolated agent's contribution to the network consensus.
